verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable relay server, but the evidence pack never documents any product telemetry, usage tracking, or a way to disable it. The only mention of 'telemetry' (moq-relay-docs-17) describes carrying application telemetry channels over relays, a different feature. The option to self-host a private CDN is an adjacent deployment choice, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
